findings.title: Bounded firing still waits for the entire pass
findings.description: `run()` uses blocking `subprocess.run()`, while `deploy/mt-run:129` waits until the service ends. Consequently, journal polling cannot begin while backfill is running, and the new stop-at-trailing-completion behavior never executes in time. Start the service non-blockingly or supervise the streaming subprocess concurrently. The mocked tests bypass this blocking behavior.

findings.title: Sudo policy grants root execution of operator-controlled code
findings.description: The passwordless rule executes an installer from the operator’s checkout as root. Anyone able to modify that checkout can replace the script and execute arbitrary root commands; restricting its arguments does not protect its contents. Install the privileged entry point in a root-owned location with root-owned parent directories and restrict its accepted operations.

findings.title: New reseeding index cannot detect spillover-only sessions
findings.description: The newly reused `build_truncated_day_index()` only joins bars inside `[session_open, session_close)` (`repair_921.py:273-289`). A session containing only the previous day’s midnight spillover has no matching bars, so it never enters this index. Meanwhile, the coarse coverage index marks that calendar day covered, preventing reseeding. Thus the historical spillover-only failure described by this change remains unrepaired. Detect covered days with no qualifying in-session bars and add a regression test using the actual spillover timestamp.
